{{Quote|Jarmak used to say that a real friend was someone who'd draw his pistol and walk down a dark alley with you if you ask 'im to.|Gaor Tembon|<ref name="YNCT" />}}
'''Jarmak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was known to the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gaor Tembon]]. At some point, Jarmak and a friend walked down a dark alley and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] five thugs who served a local [[Imperial Prefect]]. However, Jarmak's friend then put a pair of [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]] on Jarmak and handed him over to the Prefect, in return for a reward.
